subject: THE WORLD METEOROLOGICAL ORGANIZATION (WMO) HAS BEEN INFORMED BY THE
text:
THE WORLD METEOROLOGICAL ORGANIZATION (WMO) HAS BEEN INFORMED BY THE
INDIA METEOROLOGICAL DEPARTMENT THAT THEY STARTED A SECOND BROADCAST
OF METEOROLOGICAL FORECASTS AND WARNINGS VIA SAFETYNET, THROUGH ARVI,
ON 1 OCTOBER 1998. THE SECOND SCHEDULED BROADCAST TIME IS 1800 UTC
(THE ORIGINAL ONE BEING 0900 UTC). INDIA IS THE COORDINATOR FOR
NAVAREA/METAREA VIII.

subject: 1. INTERMITTENT MISSILE FIRING OPERATIONS, 0001Z TO 2400Z DAILY,
text:
1. INTERMITTENT MISSILE FIRING OPERATIONS, 0001Z TO 2400Z DAILY,
   MONDAY THRU SUNDAY IN THE PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY,
   HAWAIIAN AREA, BARKING SANDS, KAUAI. THE MAJORITY OF MISSILE
   FIRINGS TAKE PLACE BETWEEN 1600Z AND 0400Z DAILY MONDAY THRU
   FRIDAY. THE PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY HAWAIIAN AREA (W188)
   IS AN AREA BOUND BY:
   A. 22-00.0N 159-51.0W
   B. 22-00.0N 160-00.0W THENCE CCW 3 MILES FROM NIIHAU/LEHUA TO
   C. 22-02.7N 160-09.1W
   D. 22-03.0N 160-21.0W
   E. 22-05.0N 161-35.0W THENCE CW 100 MILES FROM
   F. 22-02.4N 159-47.3W (BARKING SANDS TACAN)
   G. 22-45.0N 161-25.0W
   H. 22-56.0N 161-49.0W THENCE CW 125 MILES FROM
   I. 22-02.4N 159-47.3W (BARKING SANDS TACAN)
   J. 23-57.0N 160-41.0W
   K. 25-41.0N 161-36.0W THENCE CW 240 MILES FROM
   L. 22-O2.4N 159-47.3W (BARKING SANDS TACAN)
   M. 25-47.0N 158-15.0W
   N. 23-54.0N 158-15.0W
   O. 22-20.0N 159-09.0W THENCE CCW 25 MILES FROM
   P. 21-58.1N 159-20.5W (LIHUE VORTAC)
   Q. 22-13.0N 159-42.0W THENCE CCW 3 MILES AND PARALLEL TO THE
                         SHORELINE OF KAUAI
   R. 22-00.0N 159-51.0W
2. VESSELS MAY BE REQUESTED TO ALTER COURSE WITHIN THE ABOVE AREA DUE
   TO FIRING OPERATIONS AND ARE REQUESTED TO CONTACT "MISSILE RANGE
   BARKING SANDS" ON 2182KHZ AM, 4491 USB OR 156.8 MHZ (CHANNEL 16)
   BEFORE ENTERING THE ABOVE BOUNDARIES. IF UNABLE TO CONTACT THE
   PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY PRIOR TO ENTERING OR WHILE IN THE
   WARNING AREA, RELAY MESSAGES THROUGH COAST GUARD HONOLULU.
3. VESSELS INBOUND AND OUTBOUND FOR HAWAIIAN PORTS WILL CREATE THE
   LEAST INTERFERENCE TO FIRING OPERATIONS AS WELL AS ENHANCE THE
   VESSELS SAFETY BY PASSING SOUTH OF THE ISLANDS OF KAUAI AND NIIHAU
   DURING SPECIFIED TIMES.
4. CANCEL NAVAREA XII 344/98.

3. VESSELS INBOUND AND OUTBOUND FOR SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA PORTS
